subject: Request: Headcount override + premium sign-on for Sr. Platform Engineer
messages:
From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 22:03:00 +1000
Subject: New req: urgent exception request for Sr. Platform Engineer (Fintera)

Hi Camila / Jonas —

Quick background: Ellen Park (Fintera) is our preferred candidate for the Sr. Platform Engineer role supporting their inference product integration. Candidate received a counter-offer from their current employer this morning and asked for a revised package: $35k additional sign-on cash (one-time), expedited 50% equity refresh after 6 months, and a relocation stipend. This is outside our current band for the role.

Jonas and I recommend an out-of-band exception: headcount is approved but this will need comp sign-off and a short headcount override for the month. Attached is a draft offer (offer_Fintera_ELLEN_PARK_v2.pdf) and a comp_override_request.xlsx with proposed breakdown.

Can we get a quick review and, if possible, approval by end of day tomorrow? Candidate is asking for a decision within 72 hours.

Thanks —
Grace
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_Fintera_ELLEN_PARK_v2.pdf, comp_override_request.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: New req: urgent exception request for Sr. Platform Engineer (Fintera)

Karthik / Marissa —

Forwarding Grace's thread. This hire is high priority for Fintera (strategic partner pilot) and Jonas confirms the role is mission-critical. We have one slot in this quarter's headcount plan but need a short headcount override to process the premium sign-on.

Ask: please confirm if the proposed cash sign-on ($35,000 one-time) + expedited 50% equity refresh at 6 months is approvable from comp/finance perspective and whether we need any special spend justification for the Q3 commit. If there are alternative structures (e.g., higher cash + smaller refresh) that would be easier to approve, flag them.

FWIW candidate is in APAC and will need a relocation stipend.

Thanks —
Camila
People Operations Partner | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 14:05:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Fwd: New req: urgent exception request for Sr. Platform Engineer (Fintera)

Camila —

Reviewed the attached comp_override_request.xlsx. High-level: we can approve a one-time sign-on in cash up to $30k for this band without exec approval; anything above $30k requires Director-level sign-off (Lauren). The expedited 50% equity refresh at 6 months is unusual — typical refresh cadence is annual cliffs — but we can structure it as a 6-month performance-based grant (vesting 50% at 6 months, remainder on schedule) which legal will need to sign off on. Relocation stipend is fine within policy up to $8k.

If we push cash to $35k we need a business justification memo (1 page) and Lauren's approval. Please route the memo to Lauren with recruiting + hiring manager context.

I attached a version of the spreadsheet with two scenarios (Scenario A: $30k cash + performance refresh; Scenario B: $35k cash + performance refresh + memo). Let me know which you want to proceed with.

-Karthik
Head of Comp & Benefits

Attachment: comp_override_request_v2.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:42:00 +1000
Subject: Re: Fwd: New req: urgent exception request for Sr. Platform Engineer (Fintera)

Team —

Ellen just replied to Grace — she confirmed she has an active counter-offer and will accept if we match $35k cash + faster equity. Fintera has committed to a 12‑month pilot and failing to secure Ellen will delay the pilot by at least one quarter (multi-team impact). I drafted the 1-page justification below and attached it to this reply:

---
Business justification (summary): Candidate is the only engineer with both low-latency inference production experience on Triton and the specific cloud-region deployment expertise Fintera needs. Delaying hire jeopardizes deployment SLA for pilot and could push revenue recognition timeline. The $5k incremental cash over standard band is a near-term cost but reduces risk of losing a strategic customer and accelerates a $600k contract milestone.
---

I recommend Scenario B (the $35k + 50% refresh as performance grant). Please escalate to Lauren for sign-off; we need a final answer within 48 hours.

Jonas
Director, Platform Engineering

Attachments: headcount_override_justification.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 22:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: New req: urgent exception request for Sr. Platform Engineer (Fintera) — APPROVED (conditional)

Approving Scenario B with the following conditions:
1) Cash sign-on capped at $35,000 (one-time) and paid out upon start;
2) Equity refresh to be issued as a performance-based grant with 50% vest at 6 months, legal to review agreements;
3) Relocation stipend capped at $8,000;
4) Hiring manager to confirm in Offer that early refresh is tied to measurable pilot milestones;
5) Offer to include a clawback clause for the one-time payment if the candidate leaves within 6 months.

Camila — please route the formal offer with these conditions and copy Finance for payment provisioning. We should record the headcount override in the HR ticket (HR-4321) and tag this as an expedited hire.

Lauren Bishop
VP People Operations | Redwood Inference

On approval: please send candidate the updated offer and capture signed DocuSign within 48 hours to close the loop.
